headline.season_message: A lightweight DUVETICA wind jacket styled for premium leisure, quiet luxury, and Mediterranean summer movement.

keywords_3.rationale: DUVETICA 27SS WJ should feel premium, restrained, and active without becoming technical sportswear.
The scene should read as resort wellness: soft sun, stone architecture, fresh air, and calm movement.
The wind jacket product DNA depends on light nylon, soft volume, drawstring/zip details, and refined neutral color.

quiet luxury travel moment in Mediterranean architecture

scenes.title: Luxury Wellness
scenes.tone: Ivory, cream stone, beige sand, oatmeal, sage, and a restrained wellness blue accent.
scenes.mood: Premium leisure, old money sportive, quiet luxury, Mediterranean summer, calm active elegance.
scenes.visual: A high-end editorial resort wellness image: lightweight wind jacket integrated from the beginning, natural movement, refined styling, soft nylon texture, no pasted try-on feeling.
scenes.location: Mediterranean villa, pale stone terrace, resort garden path, poolside corridor, or quiet coastal street in warm morning daylight.

dna_grid.experience: Morning resort air, polished movement, understated comfort.
dna_grid.core: Old Money Sportive meets active wellness.
dna_grid.goal: Generate five influencer-reference campaign cuts that preserve one DUVETICA WJ product while letting the rest of the outfit and scene breathe.

core_hook.definition: The influencer reference controls pose and camera, while the product packshot controls only the wind jacket DNA.
